newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo stocks end steady in foreign led trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombo stocks end steady in foreign led trade.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed barely moved in foreign dominated trade on Monday as local investors kept to the sidelines, brokers said.

The all share index closed 0.85 points lower at 606.05. Price gains and declines ran neck and neck. Blue chips Hayleys Ltd fell four rupees to 185 and Hatton National Bank Ltd two to 230, but the declines were cushioned by a 25 cent gain in John Keells Holdings Ltd, one of the highest cap stocks in Colombo.
"Many local investors have taken 15 to 20 percent in profits, and want to see if the index will fall further," said Dimantha Kohombanwickremage a trader at NDBS Stock Brokers.
Turnover was 63.35 million rupees, including foreign buying of 245,600 John Keells Holdings at 192 rupees and 30,000 National Development Bank at 205.
"These blue chips can always be placed with a foreign investor, provided you can source them in quantity," said Gordon Nadesan a broker at CT Smith.
